descriptionInUI: Plans front lines in sectors with objectives and runs them live during the mission: terrain-aware battle positions, reserve task forces that counter-attack, broken units falling back to cover, breakthroughs exploited toward the enemy base, ambushes, and smarter front line artillery (fires only on spotted enemies, prioritizes air defence and counter-battery, shoots and scoots). Adds a 'Front line status' radio menu.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Show sector objectives on the F10 map
